correctness.rationale: Exact covariance formula reduces comparisons to the pair-neighborhood-union polynomial. Identical degree margins fix its pair count and first derivative at one; it also vanishes at zero. The degree-three one-sign conclusion follows algebraically. The four-primary/four-plant finite cutoff is exhausted by 2747 row-multisets in 53 distinct feature comparisons and independently by 43744 labeled matrices across plant counts one through four. The five-plant witness has histograms (1,2,7,0) and (0,6,2,2), giving the exact factor 2q(1-q)^2(1-2q). All integer/rational computations were replayed from the standalone checker; finite census proves only the finite case.

value.rationale: Coextinction-count variance captures volatility that expected loss and both guild degree sequences cannot distinguish. Proving that every degree-matched comparison on at most three pollinators has parameter-independent sign, and that four pollinators with exactly five plants first admit a reversal, is a natural sharp boundary for degree-preserving ecological network rewiring. This does not infer real-world occurrence or make a policy claim.
